title: Human resources
description: Employees, Qiwa, advances, leave, and profile
employeesDesc: View headcount, set salaries, targets, and absence discounts
newEmployeeDesc: Create the HR file and (by default) an app login so they can open My Profile.
sectionPersonalHint: Identity, contact details, documents, and employment type.
sectionFinancialHint: Salary, sales incentives, IBAN, and advance allowance.
sectionShiftsHint: Choose one shift, two shifts, or a flexible multi-window schedule.
sectionWorkingHoursHint: Company-wide work type is set in settings. Badge ID is for attendance devices.
companyWorkingHoursMissing: Business hours are not configured yet.
createAppLoginHint: Creates a staff account linked to this file and shows a one-time password so you can test without emailing the client.
loginRoleCashierHint: For POS roles: choose Cashier / Sales rep / Marketer, then assign them under Sales → POS → Add cashier. Permissions come from Roles & permissions.
appLoginCredentialsHint: Shown once. Use it to test My Profile, or share with the employee. They can update phone/IBAN from their profile.
jobTitleAddDescription: Enter the title name, code, and permissions — it will appear in the job title list.
employmentCategoryHint: Choose employment contract, Ajeer, or trial period.
workShiftHint: Assign the employee to a roster shift from the company business hours ({mode}).
workShiftMissing: No active shifts yet. Configure business hours and generate shifts before hiring.
lateDiscountDefaultHint: Defaults to basic salary ÷ 30. HR can edit this on the employee financial tab.
editFinancialSettings: Edit salary, late fee & sales incentives
salesIncentiveHint: Choose a fixed sales target, a % of approved sales, or both. Commission is calculated automatically from approved sales.
qiwaVerifiedHint: Set when creating the employee. If not registered, you can update it later from Edit employee.
ibanOptionalHint: Optional. Saudi IBAN only: 24 characters starting with SA (checksum validated).
ibanHint: Saudi IBAN only (SA + 22 digits, checksum verified). Leave blank to keep the current value.
ibanCurrentHint: Currently on file: •••• {last4}. Enter a new Saudi IBAN only if you need to change it.
identityNumberHint: Saudi format only — National ID: 10 digits starting with 1. Iqama: 10 digits starting with 2 (checksum validated).
identityNumberCitizenHint: National ID: exactly 10 digits starting with 1 (checksum). Example: {example}
identityNumberResidentHint: Iqama: exactly 10 digits starting with 2 (checksum). Example: {example}
advanceAllowanceHint: Max advance = % of earnings this month. Earnings = (basic salary ÷ 30) × days PRESENT/LATE/REMOTE. Currency SAR.
ewalletManageHint: Balance updates when advances are approved or when HR adjusts it here. Each change is logged below.
ewalletNone: No wallet yet — set an opening balance below or approve a salary advance.
salesProgressHint: Monthly progress from APPROVED sales only. Cash counts after cash approval. Commission = approved sales × sales %. Over 100% target allowed.
salesSubmissionsHint: Cash / receipt approvals for employee sales
salesCashApprovalHint: Cash sales need Approve here (permission hr.sales_cash.approve). Card/transfer/network need a receipt first.
noPayableInvoices: No open invoices with a balance. Create/issue an invoice under Sales first.
emptyReport: No report data for this range
reportPickRange: Choose a date range and load the personal report.
profileIncomplete: Incomplete — missing insurance, residency/ID, or IBAN
qiwaStatusNote: Document employment contracts through Qiwa manually. This platform does not sync with Qiwa automatically.
qiwaNotStartedHint: This employee's employment contract has not yet been documented through Qiwa.
qiwaStartDialogHint: Review employee and contract details before opening Qiwa.
qiwaManualNote: You will be redirected to Qiwa to create and send the employment contract. This platform does not automatically receive updates from Qiwa. You must return here after completing each step.
qiwaPopupBlocked: Browser blocked the Qiwa popup. Use the Open Qiwa link below, or open https://www.qiwa.sa manually.
qiwaOpenBlockedHint: Qiwa is an external government site. If it fails to load, copy and open this link in your browser:
qiwaMarkSentConfirmBody: Have you created and sent the employment contract to the employee through Qiwa? The employee should now receive the contract in Qiwa for review and acceptance.
qiwaInProgressHint: Complete the contract creation process in Qiwa.
qiwaAwaitingHint: The contract has been sent through Qiwa and is waiting for the employee to accept it.
qiwaConfirmDesc: Enter the Qiwa contract reference and upload the documented contract PDF. A manager (Owner/Admin) must approve before the employee is marked as documented.
qiwaConfirmFinal: By submitting, you confirm the reference and PDF match the Qiwa documentation. Final approval is done by a manager.
qiwaPendingApprovalHint: HR submitted the Qiwa reference and PDF. Waiting for Owner/Admin approval.
qiwaRetry: Edit Contract and Retry in Qiwa
shiftsStub: Shift rules will be defined later. Assignment UI is a placeholder for now.
reportStub: Personal report (leaves, advances, sales, attendance) for the selected period.
meSalesStub: Submit sales with payment method. Cash needs finance supervisor approval; card/transfer/network need a receipt.
name: Name
emptyFiltered: No results match your search or filter
submitOnCreate: Submit and activate now (apply salary & target)
advancesDesc: On approve, the amount is credited to the employee wallet. When marked paid (after approval), the wallet is debited. Payroll paid status also debits attendance/advance deductions.
advanceCannotSelfApprove: Another manager must decide your own advance
editEmployeeDesc: Change any field. Unchanged values stay as they are.

flash.employeeCreatedWithLogin: Employee and app login created — copy credentials below
flash.qiwaProofRequired: Upload Qiwa registration proof when marking as registered
flash.saleReceiptRequired: A receipt is required for each network/transfer sale
flash.saleAmountRequired: Enter a valid amount greater than zero

devicesDesc: Connect cameras and biometric machines; punches auto-update attendance and payroll discounts
meDesc: Update your contact details and IBAN. Salary, shifts, and employment settings are managed by HR.
employeeDetailHrManageHint: Company-managed data (salary, shifts, employment, financial settings) is edited here by HR. Leave, advance, and sales requests are submitted by the employee in their portal — shown below for review only.
employeeRequestsViaPortalHint: New requests are submitted by the employee from their portal (/me), not from this screen.
employeePortalEditHint: Update your phone, email, and IBAN. Name, salary, shifts, and employment details are managed by your company in HR.
meNoProfile: No employee profile is linked to your user account.
advanceCapHint: Your advance is capped at a % of this month's earnings (attendance days × daily rate).
qiwaProofFileHint: Upload a PDF/image of Qiwa proof. The employee will be marked as registered.
workContractHint: PDF or image — for employment or wage-worker contracts.
trialPeriodHint: Near the end you will see an alert with a Qiwa registration option. After Qiwa registration they become registered and convert to employment or Ajeer.
trialEndingHint: Register the employee on Qiwa, then convert to employment or Ajeer:
identityPhotoHint: Upload a photo or PDF of the national ID or Iqama.
commissionNoTarget: Fixed salary + % on all sales (no target)
commissionHintTarget: Set the target, then choose a fixed reward or a % of sales after the target.
commissionHintNoTarget: Commission % on all approved sales with no target threshold.
commissionCashierSkippedHint: Hidden for cashier, and for marketer unless the role has invoice-create permission. Sales reps keep commission fields.
allowancesHint: Pick allowances from the company list and enter each amount.
allowancesEmpty: No allowance types yet — add company types below first.
allowanceTypesHint: Add or remove allowance types available when hiring.
shiftPatternHint: Set start and end for each work window.
saleCashHint: For cash, enter the total cash sales amount only.
saleMultiHint: For network/transfer, set how many sales and upload a receipt per sale.
